svg.title: noderaven: a year of contributions surveyed as terrain
svg.desc: Topographic map of 1,531 GitHub contributions from 12 Oct 2025 to 17 Oct 2026. Each day is a survey point; busy days rise into hills. 8 on 12 Mar 2026, 109 on 24 Jun 2026, 158 on 15 Oct 2026, 101 on 11 Oct 2026.
svg.text: A year of commits, surveyed as terrain
I harden identity, Microsoft 365 and endpoints, study how
systems break, and build the tools that come out of it.
1,531 contributions, 12 Oct 2025 to 17 Oct 2026. Surveyed 17 Oct 2026 by GitHub Actions.

g.text: Contours rise with each day’s commits
